installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl wget ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 tar gzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd

cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

echo "Downloading SteamCMD..."

rm -f steamcmd.tar.gz

curl -L --fail -o steamcmd.tar.gz \
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz

echo "Extracting SteamCMD..."
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz

chmod +x steamcmd.sh

cd /mnt/server

echo "Installing SCP: Secret Laboratory Dedicated Server..."

/mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh \
    +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
    +login anonymous \
    +app_update 996560 validate \
    +quit

echo "Cleaning SteamCMD installer files..."
rm -f /mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.tar.gz

if [ -f /mnt/server/LocalAdmin ]; then
    chmod +x /mnt/server/LocalAdmin
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/SCPSL ]; then
    chmod +x /mnt/server/SCPSL
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/config
mkdir -p /mnt/server/configs
mkdir -p /mnt/server/AppData

echo ""
echo "=============================================="
echo " SCP: Secret Laboratory installation complete"
echo "=============================================="
echo "Server files: /mnt/server"
echo "Startup: ./LocalAdmin {{SERVER_PORT}}"
echo "=============================================="
